groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Safest Choice: Low-Calorie Snack Bar
groups.comparisonSentence: This option contains significantly fewer calories and less total fat per 100g than the bakery items, helping mitigate your calorie and saturated fat surpluses.
groups.message: This snack bar aligns best with your need to curb caloric surplus and saturated fat intake while keeping sodium minimal. However, it remains low in protein and fibre. Order or select this item when craving a light snack, and pair it with an unsweetened protein source or vegetable sticks to cover your dietary fibre and protein gaps.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Neutral Choice: Moderate Carbohydrate Loaf Bread
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to the sweet pastries, this white loaf provides moderate calories and lower saturated fat, though it still contributes to your carbohydrate surplus.
groups.message: This white loaf bread has moderate lipid levels and controlled sodium, making it acceptable in strict moderation. It does not actively resolve your carbohydrate or added sugar surpluses, and lacks sufficient fibre. Pair a single slice with lean protein and raw greens to balance your macronutrient profile.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Warning Choice: High-Fat & Sugar Bakery Items
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike the lighter snack bar, these rich bakery items severely exacerbate your active saturated fat, carbohydrate, and added sugar surpluses.
groups.message: These croissants and sweet filled breads carry concentrated loads of saturated fat and refined sugars that directly worsen your 3-day nutritional surpluses.
